Game Overview

Aqua Dash puts players into a casual experience centered on race your speedboat through wild ocean waves in Aqua Dash. Outsmart coastguards, collect stars, and unlock faster boats. Use cunning tactics like enemy-slowing anchors and disabling mines. Each level ups the challenge, demanding sharp focus and swift reflexes. Are you the ultimate sea racer? Dive in!
